tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Jobs — Opens the Worklittle jobs MAP for a place and an optional role. This is a map query, not a list of jobs: the map recenters on the place and shows jobs there, so send the place and the role as SEPARATE fields. Never write 'product manager in San Francisco' as one query. PLACE: always pass near

If the user asks for full details of a role without an id (e.g. the first software engineer job in Austin), pass query and opt

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Jobs — Returns aggregate job-market statistics from Worklittle. Call with no args for the full indexed market (counts, workplace mix, top hiring companies). When the user names a role and/or city (e.g. product managers in San Francisco), pass query and location. The filtered slice includes match cou

tools.name: track_applied_job
tools.description: Jobs — Add a job to the user's Applied or Saved list, or change its status, so they can find it later.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's Worklittle profile (name, location, contact details and job preferences). If they have not linked their account it returns connected false; use get_my_resume or apply_for_job to sign them in.

tools.name: list_recent_chats
tools.description: Jobs — List the user's recent Worklittle chats (title and status) for the app sidebar.

tools.name: mint_mcp_ui_embed_session
tools.description: Jobs — Create a sign-in link so the Worklittle app can open the user's chats on worklittle.com.

tools.name: logout_connected_account
tools.description: Jobs — Sign the user out of Worklittle in this app.

tools.name: upload_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Save the resume the user attached in the chat (PDF, Word, text or image) as the main resume on their Worklittle profile so it can be used to apply. It replaces the current main resume; other saved resumes (an account keeps up to 5) stay. Pass the attached file as resume_file.

tools.name: get_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's main resume: its status (ready, processing or missing) and, when ready, the resume text and profile details read from it. Use it to tailor advice or an application to the user's real experience.

tools.name: delete_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Delete the user's main resume from their profile. Other saved resumes stay.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Jobs — Update the user's Worklittle profile, such as name, location, phone, links or the kind of job they want. Only send the fields to change.

tools.name: apply_for_job
tools.description: Jobs — Apply to a job for the user: Worklittle fills out and submits the application in a browser. Pass job_id from search_jobs. For a Worklittle-hosted posting also include name, email and resume. It submits by default; pass auto_submit false when the user wants to review first, then show them the

tools.name: check_application_status
tools.description: Jobs — Check an application Worklittle is filling out: its status, which form fields are filled, and a live view link. Only the status completed means it was submitted.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Jobs — Send an application that stopped for review (apply_for_job with auto_submit false, status awaiting_submit). Call it only after the user has seen the answers from check_application_status and said to send it.

tools.name: stop_application
tools.description: Jobs — Stop an application that Worklittle is filling out for the user. This cancels the application in progress and it cannot be resumed; the user would have to start it again. Needs the session_id from apply_for_job or list_active_applications.

tools.name: steer_application
tools.description: Jobs — Change what an application in progress fills in, without stopping it. Use when the user says something about an application Worklittle is filling right now ("say my notice period is one month", "my friend Ana Ruiz referred me", "I need visa sponsorship for the US", "make that answer shorter")

tools.name: save_about_me
tools.description: Jobs — Save standing facts about the user that Worklittle's Apply with AI uses on every future application: work authorization and visa sponsorship by country, relocation, notice period, desired salary, languages, qualifications, who referred them, or other standing answers they ask applications to

tools.name: list_active_applications
tools.description: Jobs — List the user's applications that Worklittle is filling out right now (queued, running, or waiting on the user), with job_id and session_id. Use it to find which one to stop or check.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: Jobs — List applications: pending ones (matched by auto-apply, waiting for approval, running, or waiting on the user) and finished ones (completed = submitted, failed, stopped). Check it before applying so the same job is never applied to twice. Filter with status (pending, applied, ...), job_id or

tools.name: get_apply_settings
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's apply settings: auto_apply (Worklittle applies to matching jobs on its own), auto_submit (submit without a review stop) and tailor_resume (tailor the resume to each job).

tools.name: update_apply_settings
tools.description: Jobs — Turn auto_apply, auto_submit or tailor_resume on or off. Only send the settings to change. Turning auto_apply on needs Instant or a card on file.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" is 4655 chars, far longer than this server's median (214). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.worklittle.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, list_recent_chats, mint_mcp_ui_embed_session, get_apply_settings · Private data: search_jobs, get_my_profile, upload_my_resume, update_apply_settings · Public sink: search_jobs, get_market_overview, upload_my_resume, update_my_profile, apply_for_job, submit_application, steer_application, get_apply_settings, update_apply_settings · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_my_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, list_recent_chats, mint_mcp_ui_embed_session, get_apply_settings · Private data: search_jobs, get_my_profile, upload_my_resume, update_apply_settings · Public sink: search_jobs, get_market_overview, upload_my_resume, update_my_profile, apply_for_job, submit_application, steer_application, get_apply_settings, update_apply_settings · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_my_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
